title: Introducing the SlimFile University Ambassador Program
subtitle: Students at 13 universities in Ghana, Mauritius and the United States now represent SlimFile on their campuses, helping classmates work faster with their files.

highlights.title: 13 campuses in 3 countries
highlights.note: Ambassadors are active at UCC, UG, UMaT, KNUST, UDS, KAAF University, GCTU, Takoradi Technical University, UENR and Central University in Ghana, the African Leadership College of Higher Education in Mauritius, and Hampden-Sydney College and Livingstone College in the United States.

highlights.title: Helping students where they study
highlights.note: Ambassadors show classmates how to get assignments under portal size limits, convert and merge files, scan documents with a phone, and write in SlimDocx.

highlights.title: A path to grow
highlights.note: Ambassadors run campus campaigns, earn recognition and move up through program levels, while gaining real experience with a Ghanaian technology company.

title: Meet SlimDocx: A Full Word-Style Editor, Free on SlimFile
subtitle: Write and edit documents with pages, tables and track changes, open Word files, and download as Word or PDF, all in your browser. Powered by ONLYOFFICE.

highlights.title: Everything you expect from Word
highlights.note: Pages, headings, tables, images, comments and track changes, in a familiar toolbar, with nothing to install.

highlights.title: Works with your Word files
highlights.note: Import a .docx file, edit it, and download it again as Word or PDF when you are done.

highlights.title: Saves automatically
highlights.note: Documents are saved to your SlimFile account, so you can pick up where you left off on any device.

title: New SlimFile Whiteboards: An Endless Canvas for Your Ideas
subtitle: SlimFile Whiteboards has been rebuilt from the ground up, with a smooth, endless canvas for sketching, diagrams and planning.

highlights.title: Sketch, diagram and plan
highlights.note: Draw freehand, add shapes, arrows and text, and lay out ideas on a canvas that never runs out of room.

highlights.title: Saved automatically
highlights.note: Every board saves to your SlimFile account as you draw, ready to reopen on any device.

highlights.title: All your boards in one place
highlights.note: A redesigned My Whiteboards page makes it easy to find, rename and organise your boards.

title: Follow SlimFile on WhatsApp
subtitle: SlimFile now has an official WhatsApp Channel, with news, new features, file tips and job openings, straight to your phone.

highlights.title: News first
highlights.note: Hear about new tools and updates as soon as they launch.

highlights.title: File tips
highlights.note: Short, practical tips for getting files under upload limits and working faster.

highlights.title: Job openings
highlights.note: When SlimFile is hiring, the channel is the first place we will share it.

title: SlimFile Mobile App Now Available on Google Play Store
subtitle: SlimFile launches its official Android app, bringing file compression and conversion to your pocket. Compress images, PDFs and Office documents on the go, free on the Google Play Store.

highlights.title: Compress files anywhere
highlights.note: Compress images, PDFs, DOCX and XLSX files right from your Android device before sharing or uploading.

highlights.title: Convert formats on the go
highlights.note: Convert images to PDF, Office documents to PDF and more, directly from your phone.

highlights.title: Free and private
highlights.note: All features are free, and your files are processed and then deleted, never stored on our servers.

title: Introducing SlimFile AI Lab: 9 AI Tools in One Place
subtitle: SlimFile launches AI Lab, a suite of free AI tools to translate, summarise, rewrite, analyse sentiment, compare texts, write emails and more.

highlights.title: 9 AI tools in one place
highlights.note: Translate text, summarise documents, rewrite content, ask questions about documents, extract keywords, analyse sentiment, compare texts, write emails and check for plagiarism.

highlights.title: Free to use
highlights.note: All AI Lab tools are free, with no subscription.

highlights.title: Works with your documents
highlights.note: Upload a PDF, Word or text file and let AI answer questions, summarise it or pull out the key points.

title: 8 New Image Tools on SlimFile
subtitle: SlimFile adds a suite of image tools: resize, crop, enhance, watermark, remove or replace backgrounds, blur faces, and generate thumbnails, all free with a live preview.

highlights.title: 8 essential image tools
highlights.note: Resize, crop, auto-enhance, add text or image watermarks, remove or replace backgrounds, blur faces, and create thumbnails.

highlights.title: Live preview
highlights.note: See exactly how your image will look before you download it.

highlights.title: Quality first
highlights.note: PNG, JPEG and WebP support, aspect ratio kept, and optional compression.

title: SlimFile Reaches 10,000 New Users
subtitle: A major growth milestone: 10,000 new users and 9,700 active users, with 468,113 events and 59,332 views across SlimFile.

highlights.title: 10,000 new users
highlights.note: Strong adoption across students, professionals and teams.

highlights.title: 9,700 active users
highlights.note: People coming back to SlimFile to compress, convert and manage their files.

highlights.title: 468,113 events
highlights.note: Files compressed, converted and shared across all of SlimFile's tools.

title: SlimAudio: Audio Compression Is Now Live
subtitle: SlimFile expands beyond documents and images with SlimAudio, an audio compression platform for MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A and more.

highlights.title: Many audio formats
highlights.note: Compress MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG and more while keeping excellent sound quality.

highlights.title: Made for podcasters and creators
highlights.note: Smaller files for faster uploads, streaming and sharing, without sacrificing sound.

subtitle: A television spotlight on how SlimFile helps people compress and convert files faster and more securely.

highlights.title: A TV feature and walk-through
highlights.note: GTV aired a segment on what SlimFile is, who it is for, and how compression and conversion work in practice.

highlights.title: The story behind SlimFile
highlights.note: Why lighter, simpler files matter for students, professionals and teams across Ghana and beyond.

highlights.title: Everyday uses
highlights.note: Smaller PDFs, faster uploads, and converting between common formats.
